title: Aurora replay catalog and SLA attestation for dedicated capacity throughput
creator: Marco Chen
description: Build and validate the 'Aurora' replay catalog: a deterministic, tenant-aware replay and synthetic shaping harness for certifying Dedicated capacity throughput SLOs, exercising autoscaler policies, and providing a reproducible customer acceptance bundle. This ticket covers harness orchestration, fidelity profiles, benchmark methodology, acceptance checklist for customer pilots, and automation to produce signed evidence artifacts (metrics, traces, and artifact bundle).
acceptance_criteria: Aurora harness can play back recorded request traces with configurable deterministic timing and per-tenant weighting
Recorded+synthetic fidelity profiles for three workload classes (steady QPS, ramp-to-burst, and microburst) are defined and stored in the catalog
End-to-end benchmarking reports (CSV + human-readable summary) are produced for each run and uploaded to the run artifacts dashboard
Autoscaler policy experiments can be orchestrated against the harness and reproduce observed scale events deterministically
Customer acceptance checklist is documented; at least one pilot customer signoff run completed and artifacts stored in Drive/GCS
Run artifacts include 50/90/95/99 tail latency, p50/p95 token cost, scale event timeline, and KV cache hit rates for every run
test_plan: Catalog onboarding: ingest three anonymized production traces from internal staging tenants and normalize to the Aurora schema
Profile synthesis: derive synthetic shaping parameters (inter-arrival distribution, batch size distribution, prompt length histogram) and store as fidelity profiles
Deterministic runner: implement single-threaded timing controller to ensure identical playback across runs; seed RNGs for any stochastic components
Autoscaler experiments: create experiments to vary target_utilization, cool_down, and max_scale_steps; run each experiment against the same workload profile and record scale events
Fleet controls verification: exercise routing policies (fallback model variant, region failover) under load and collect routing decision traces
Customer acceptance: run signed acceptance job with expectation thresholds, generate an acceptance bundle, and circulate to customer SRE for signoff
run_results: 2026-03-05: steady-qps profile at 3k QPS, sustained 30m: p50=42ms p95=78ms p99=154ms, token-cost-per-req=0.0052, KV cache hit=68%

2026-03-08: ramp-to-burst profile, ramp 0->8k QPS in 90s: observed autoscaler scaled from 2->10 replicas within 120s; tail latency spike p99=320ms during scale; root cause: conservative cool_down=180s

2026-03-10: microburst profile (100 bursts of 12k QPS for 8s): transient error rate 0.6%, failure mode isolated to overflow queue backpressure; mitigations: increase burst buffer and enable soft-drop policy
Signed evidence bundle for pilot tenant ABC (run 2026-03-10) uploaded to Drive and linked in artifacts
